residual_dependence.centering: Subtract each route/kind training-sample mean for description only. No predictive parameter is changed.
residual_dependence.interpretation: These are unconditional actual-minus-forecast residual correlations. Shared trip/day shocks, overlapping states and forecast construction can induce them. They do not directly test or refute conditional independence of forecast messages given the entire latent physical trajectory. Pairs share endpoints/trips; counts are support descriptions, not independent sample sizes.

selector.rule: Per physical trip, remove all forecast slots at or before its latest hard-observed slot. Among remaining slots choose latest received time, then earliest physical slot. Without hard observations all slots remain eligible. No scheduled/predicted-time filter is applied.

endpoint_panel.source: All queries are reproducible from the existing V35 event/message tables; examples use encounter order.

onboard_panel.source: All queries are reproducible from the existing V35 event/message tables; examples use encounter order.

selector.assessment: The selector uses received messages, known static slot order and hard public observations only, so it is implementable at the decision time. It is a one-message likelihood approximation with the same full public record, not a conditional-independence model or an optimal selector. A selected scheduled time in the past can be a delayed unobserved service; that condition is not itself a causality error.
